findings: Turn gait has no stepping: turn_left/turn_right apply only a static PelvYR/PelvYL += a*0.3 yaw offset with no phase-dependent leg oscillation, so in-place turning stability is unverified. Validate turning in Webots and add leg stepping during turns if the robot does not rotate. (non-blocking, Webots tuning)

Non-knee joint limits in JOINT_LIMITS are conservative assumptions, not read from Darwin-op.proto (author-documented, sandbox had no network). Reconcile against the PROTO when network access exists in case real ranges are tighter and cause excessive clamping. (non-blocking)

Physical gait quality is unvalidated: no Webots runtime in the sandbox, so stand/forward/turn stability and cessation of knee warnings are unconfirmed. Run locomotion_test with each LOCO_CMD before training the four agents. (non-blocking, by design)
